title: Any Mushroom Recipe
description: Allows for any mushroom to be used in the recipes of stews.
body:
#### About
This small datapack allows you to use any kind of mushroom in the crafting recipes that require mushrooms.

All of the mushrooms are allowed in crafting:
- Brown Mushroom
- Red Mushroom
- Crimson Fungus
- Warped Fungus

The datapack affects recipes for further items:
- mushroom stew
- rabbit stew
- suspicious stew (all variants)
- fermented spider eye

<hr>

#### Compatibility (BETA)
Working on compatibility for Better Nether and Better End

Applies to:
- Hook Mushroom (Better Nether)
- Chorus Mushroom (Better End)
- Bolux Mushroom (Better End)

<hr>

#### Game Version
v1.0 works only with 1.21.8
v1.1 works with 1.21 and some versions prior

<hr>

#### Tips for Adjustment
If you want to remove the nether fungi from the recipes:
1. Go to the datapack folder: `...\data\minecraft\tags\item`
2. Open `any_mushroom.json`
3. Remove the items you don't want to be use
4. Go to `...\data\minecraft\recipe`
5. Remove further files:
    - `rabbit_stew_from_crimson_fungus.json`
    - `rabbit_stew_from_warped_fungus.json`
